name: IC — 5V, 5.5V — QFP
description: Surface-mount IC cluster operating at 5V to 5.5V in 32-pin QFP packages, including TQFP-32 and LQFP-32 7x7mm footprints with 0.8mm pitch.
selection_hints: Selecting an IC requiring a 5V or 5.5V supply voltage in a 32-pin QFP package.
Targeting SMD footprints such as TQFP-32 or LQFP-32 with a 7x7mm body and 0.8mm pitch.
Choosing tier A JLCPCB KiCad library parts like ATmega328P-AU or STM8S105K6T6C.
avoid_when: The design requires through-hole mounting instead of SMD.
The application requires a package family other than 32-pin QFP.
Operating voltage requirements differ from 5V or 5.5V.
